scope: Seven example hubs, one per listed city. Links are public passenger references, separate from the sample planning model. Airport operators do not supply or operate the worked example.

airports.name: John F. Kennedy International Airport
airports.context: The Port Authority's current passenger map and terminal directory list these terminal groups.

airports.name: Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport
airports.context: These are the current terminal groupings in the operator’s 2026 reference material. Groupe ADP announced a passenger wayfinding and terminal naming change for March 2027; this list is not an availability statement for each individual facility.

sources.label: Paris Aéroport passenger map, Terminal 2 area

airports.name: Munich Airport
airports.context: The Terminal 2 satellite is part of Terminal 2, not a separately numbered terminal. The new Terminal 1 Pier is part of Terminal 1 and entered passenger service in April 2026.

airports.name: Frankfurt Airport
airports.context: The current passenger map describes Terminal 1 and Terminal 3. Fraport halted Terminal 2 passenger operations in June 2026 for refurbishment.

airports.name: Tirana International Airport
airports.context: The airport links to a passenger terminal map and describes expanding that terminal during 2026. The downloadable map is reference-only and is not used as an up-to-date gate inventory.

sources.label: Tirana International Airport terminal expansion update

airports.name: Rome Fiumicino Airport
airports.context: The 2026 Aeroporti di Roma service charter identifies Terminals 1 and 3 for passengers and publishes departure and arrival maps.

sources.label: Aeroporti di Roma 2026 terminal maps (ENAC-hosted PDF, printed page 112 onward)

airports.name: Heathrow Airport
airports.context: Heathrow publishes passenger maps and terminal guides for its four current passenger terminals.
